description: Start a new registration: creates the business (as a draft) with the name the user wants to register, in the workspace they're in (pass `workspace` only when they ask for the other one). A personal registration needs a verified WhatsApp number: without one it returns whatsapp_unverified (request_whatsapp_verification sets it up).

name.description: The business name they want to register.
